Name: Hadron Engine
Description: Hadron Engine (Ability 289). Sets Electric Terrain upon switch-in (timing 0xA7 via 0x5F200) and boosts Special Attack by 33% (1.33x in Q12 fixed-point) while Electric Terrain is active during damage calculation (timing 0x4A via terrain check 0xE2274 and stat boost channel 0x83108).
